icon.description: Sweeping weapon with a slight cooldown and good damage.

use.title: $$ability$ Block
use.desc:
Hold your sword forward, blocking a portion of damage as long as your meter is filled.

Above 75% meter, you can perform perfect blocks, if damage is blocked while it's glowing, blocking all damage without consuming meter.

icon.ability_boost: Increases max meter and decreases how much damage ignores the block.
